findings.issue: Common noun H7676 (singular construct) is left as the untranslated lemma shabat.
Qal active participle of sojourn (H1481 a) is rendered as peregrinantes, adding pilgrimage.
Suffix is 2fs after a string of 2ms suffixes; contigo does not show the feminine and reads as the same tú.

notes: 2mp ustedes then 2ms ti/tu, and construct de la tierra, match the tokens.
